title: Processed inputs for nycped: pedestrian harm crashes and census tract covariates, New York City, 2019 to 2023
description: Two processed input files for the nycped analysis of pedestrian harm and neighborhood poverty in New York City: a table of 37,815 pedestrian harm crashes (2019 to 2023) and a table of 2,189 census tracts with American Community Survey and land use covariates. See the README for columns, sources, and checksums.
